shared_elements: schematic facial/eye features rendered in low relief
low-relief figural carving on a flat vertical face
justification: Both are upright slabs carrying schematic low-relief carving, and A's simple eyes-and-nose face has a loose counterpart in the schematic eyed heads of B's creatures, but that is about as generic as monumental relief gets. A depicts a single bare human face and nothing else, whereas B depicts a crowded, register-organised menagerie of quadrupeds, birds, snakes and a hatched band, with no human face at all.
